title: Expedition 70 Astronaut Loral O’Hara Talks with KAKE-TV, Wichita, Kansas (NASA, public domain)
method: Labelled from the text of the whisper.cpp base transcript of hosted run 39595991957 (who calls, who asks, who answers, who is addressed by name), without listening. The run printed each engine's labels beside the text; they were not used to decide a turn. Each turn runs over whole transcript segments, so its bounds are segment bounds (precision about one segment); consecutive segments of one speaker less than two seconds apart form one turn. Segments whose speaker the text does not tell (two short interjections, a sentence cut off by the interviewer) and the laughter are unscored; the music is not speech. Read on 2026-10-21. The maintainer listened on 2026-11-18 and confirmed every turn check; they heard one voice more than this reference showed in the last stretch, so that stretch is unscored (see its reason).

speakers.A: the ground controller in Mission Control Houston, who opens the event and is heard again in its closing stretch (unscored, see the reason there)
speakers.B: the astronaut on the station, who answers
speakers.C: the television station's interviewer on the ground, who asks the questions

count_note: The interviewer, the astronaut and the controller who opens the event: a user who knows the event gives three. A short closing voice, heard in the last seconds beside Mission Control, is one a user who knows the event would not count (the same reasoning as RM06's closing controller), so a known-count run is asked for three.

unscored.reason: The closing stretch, from the astronaut's goodbye to the end of the recording: the maintainer heard two distinct voices in it on 2026-11-18, Mission Control and an unnamed fourth closing voice (not the interviewer), with no heard bounds between them, so no turn is claimed there.
